interface.evidence: Original interface lists only a, b, q, each one bit.

semantics.latency: Combinational, no added delay or storage. Observe after same-timestamp delta settling.
semantics.initialization: No state or initialization specified; original inputs at 0ns are a=0, b=0, q=0.
semantics.evidence: Original says combinational; 0ns gives 00->0, 25ns gives 01->0, 35ns gives 10->0, 45ns gives 11->1; repeated at 55/65/75/85ns.

numeric.arithmetic: No signed arithmetic, overflow, rounding or saturation.

verification.oracle: Literal expected q values from original waveform, independent of DUT expression.
verification.stimulus: Replay every original row at 0 through 90ns in 5ns increments, including repeated levels.
verification.sampling: Drive at original row timestamp; sample after #0 delta settling without advancing physical time.
verification.coverage: All four binary combinations, transitions between them, repeated observations and return to 00.
verification.failure: Case-inequality mismatch triggers $fatal; bounded timeout; PASS only after all 19 rows.

specification_ambiguities.resolution: No extra X/Z acceptance requirement; implement ordinary four-state bitwise AND.
